programs.description: A charitable trust faces threats from a powerful mafia leader who has set his eyes on its land. He plans to kill the legal heir to grab the wealth, but a brave taxi driver becomes an impediment.
Nandini, a young doctor, falls in love with Jessie, a happy-go-lucky man. But when Nandini gets married to Shyam Prasad at her parents' insistence, Jessie comes back in her life as a ghost.
A wealthy couple abandons their infant daughter in their quest to beget a son. However, a shocking revelation awaits them after their son abandons them in their twilight years.

Prince Prahlada, the pious son of an asura king, must endure his father's wrath due to his unmoving devotion towards Lord Vishnu.
The son of a police constable and an aspiring detective, Divakara begins to investigate a robbery at the police station. However, this leads him to uncover a complex web of secrets.
